messages.body:
Hi Umut,
That "warning" is OK.  I would suggest to check the density of your system to make sure it stays at a reasonable value.
Best,
Taisung

"MC Barostat:       5000 volume changes attempted.
| MC Barostat:       1372 changes successful ( 27.44%)"
I have never used MC barostat; thus, I assume these warnings/info are inherent to the MC. Are these warnings normal?
